notes.title: Ascendant Dawn 0.12.1 Update
notes.notes: [p]I've added some new content, fixed some bugs and most importantly I've implemented the save system in the demo. Currently, it's a little bare bones with just the ability to create(including overwrite) and load saves. I'm going to be adding other features such as the ability to delete saves and for the UI to give context on what's in the save and information such as when it was created. There's almost certainly some bugs with the saving system so if you find any report them on the steam forum or discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Below is a changelog with most of the changes though I haven't included everything.[/p][p][/p][p]-Changed riverbed texture[/p][p]-Added ridge hills to part of the map[/p][p]-Replacing mountains with new spline based mountains[/p][p]-Added a new technology shock troops[/p][p]-Club and axe brutes now require the new shock troops technology[/p][p]-Raiders now require the technology bronze working[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where only 2 digits would show for the troop number in the tribal army UI[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where the winter freezing sound would play times at once[/p][p]-Improved some of appearances of assets when they are close to the camera.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.10.2
notes.notes: [p]-Updated the map to include a new region and removed some of the mountains[/p][p]-Added grass in certain areas and bushes in others[/p][p]-Added waves and foam to the ocean[/p][p]-Conversations can now be had with settlements, including them suggesting where to settle.[/p][p]-Improved UI icons[/p][p]-Added tilt shift, this introduces blur when you are close to the ground[/p][p]-Some light UI improvements[/p][p]-Added characters that will always be the same at the start of the game[/p][p]-Changed ocean material[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.9
notes.notes:
0.9 adds some visual elements to the map. None of them have gameplay impacts but they do reflect the state of nearby settlements.

- Added roads between settlements and wood resources

- Added farmland that grows or shrinks depending on the number of farms in a nearby settlement

- Added ranches that grow or shrink depending on the number of ranches in a nearby settlement

- Added small settlements how's size is dependent on the number of trade connections present in nearby settlements.

notes.title: 0.8.4 Update
notes.notes:
-Improved settings menu
-Added more tooltips to the HUD
-Changed the day and night speed. Days now move slower and nights faster. This can all the customised within the settings.
-Removed hard pausing on events so music now doesn't stop during them.

If you notice any bugs or have any recommendations please inform me.
